Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. These fajita wraps make meal prep effortless and delicious🤌🏽🤤 Macros Per Wrap including sauce (10 Wraps Total) 394 Calories | 43g Protein | 27g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings / Wraps) Fajita Chicken Marinade - 1600g Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Coriander Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2-3 Tsp Chilli Powder - 1 and 1/2 Whole Lime Juice - 2.5 Tbsp Olive Oil  Fajita Veggie Mix - 200g Red Onion, chopped - 200g White Onion, chopped - 150g Red Bell Pepper, chopped - 150g Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 150g Yellow Bell Pepper, chopped - Extra Fajita Seasoning - Olive Oil Spray Topping and Wraps - 100g Low Fat Cheddar - 100g Shredded Mozzarella - Fresh Tomatoes, chopped - Fresh Coriander, finely chopped - Low Carb Tortilla Wraps (Brand: Mission Carb Balance) Spicy Sauce - 150g Yogurt of choice - 80g Light Mayo - 1/2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 50g Sriracha 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Cube the chicken thighs and season with fajita seasoning, olive oil, and lime juice. Mix until well coated and set aside. 2. Line a large sheet pan with baking paper. Add onions and bell peppers, season with extra fajita seasoning, and lightly spray with olive oil. Roast at 190C / 380F for 20 minutes to remove excess moisture. 3. Take your chicken, marinate in incredible flavours and roast it in the oven and you are left with the juiciest and most delicious chicken for the week.  9: Cajun Chicken & Peppers Calories & macros (when divided into 5) 📊 238 calories 39g P | 9g C | 6g F This is week 9 of this new recipe series and all you need to do is:  1. Add 900g boneless, skinless chicken thighs to a large bowl or tub. You can trim off the excess fat if you want but I left it . 2. Add a jar of roasted red peppers (drain most of the juice but leave some in) and optionally a jar of jalapeños. This ended up being super spicy, add half or none if you would like to reduce the spice.  3. Add 1/2 jar of cajun seasoning.  4. Add 3-4 pinches salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and 15g garlic puree.   5. Mix really well and marinate for 2-6 hrs, but even better overnight. You can also make it right away if you like. The longer you leave it, the better the flavour!  6. When you're ready to eat, preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius 375F. Place in the oven for 50 mins. 8. Remove the chicken from the oven, gently tilt the pan into a glass jar to remove the excess juices. Pour the juices over the chicken, then repeat.
